plan: This auction structure is equivalent to a second-price sealed-bid auction: the winner pays the second-highest bid, and my exit point is determined by my own sealed bid. Since I exit when the clock reaches my bid, and I pay the second-highest bid if I win, bidding my true value ($10) is a dominant strategy. This ensures I win whenever my value exceeds others' bids and pay less than my value, while never overpaying. There's no incentive to shade my bid up or down in this format.
